info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Events Ticketing Tickets Status API provides stakeholders with real-time access to the current status of tickets for various events. This API is essential for event organizers and ticketing platforms that need to monitor ticket availability, sales trends, and operational status updates. Consumers can leverage this API to inform customers about ticket status, optimize inventory management, and enhance user experience during ticket purchasing. By querying the status of tickets, businesses can make informed decisions regarding promotions and sales strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of tickets.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of tickets in the system. It provides details regarding the tickets' state and any relevant information associated with their status, helping users understand where their tickets stand.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended for retrieving the status of tickets. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify which ticket statuses are being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of the tickets.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: The request body to retrieve the status of tickets.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the ticket status retrieval was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time in milliseconds for the request.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the ticket status operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: Response object for the ticket status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the ticket.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the creation of the ticket was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Details about the audit trail for the ticket status operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request before sending the response.
